metadata.title: Rakshi Rangaprasad
metadata.description: Rakshi Rangaprasad is a junior studying computer engineering at Tufts University, interested in software, machine learning, embedded systems, robotics, and medicine.

person.name: Rakshi Rangaprasad
person.summary: I'm a junior studying computer engineering. Most of my work sits somewhere between software, machine learning, embedded systems, and robotics. I'm especially drawn to projects that serve the greater good.
person.availability: Currently looking for internships for summer 2027.

experience.detail: Built and scaled a free mentorship platform for students in the medical pipeline, now with about 200 members from undergraduate programs and medical schools around the United States.

● Reduced locale update times by 80% by engineering a streamlined update system and integrating region preference selection directly into the onboarding flow, significantly driving global locale adoption.
● Diagnosed critical bugs across TypeScript, Angular, and Java, improving application stability and user experience.
● Authored robust JUnit tests to validate complex CAD features (query updates, feature selection).
Organized a datathon judged by people working in machine learning and AI at Nasdaq and Tufts.
Started the first Pan-Asian business organization at Tufts.
Built software for English at Large in 2025 and Beantown Baby Diaper Bank in 2026.
Undergraduate research in the Department of Biomedical Engineering.
